subject: Samira Khan — comp band clarity & timeline for offer
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Samira Khan — initial feedback + comp ask

Hi Karthik / Aditya,

Attached are Samira's resume and the interview notes from yesterday (attached). Quick summary:
- Strong system design and latency optimization experience (led inference infra at previous company).
- Excellent behavioral and leadership signals — good match for an IC3/L3 role per the rubric.
- She shared a verbal expectation in the $165k-$175k base + equity range and has one competing verbal offer with a faster timeline.

Karthik, you flagged in the debrief that you see this as L3 (not L2) and recommended starting at the top of L3 band. Monica, can you confirm band placement and whether we can do a market adjustment for this candidate? We want to avoid losing her to a faster competitor.

Next steps I propose: recruiter to confirm comp expectations with candidate, hiring team provides final justification doc, HR confirms approvals needed.

Attachments: samira_khan_resume.pdf, samira_interview_notes.docx

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Samira Khan — initial feedback + comp ask

Thanks Lauren — quick notes from the hiring team:
- Interview scores: 4/5 across system design, infra, and behavioral. Consensus is L3.
- Critical: has direct experience with KV cache invalidation and latency regressions — directly relevant to us.
- I recommend we extend an L3 offer with an above-midpoint base given market and scarcity of candidates with this profile.

Justification bullets for HR:
1) Scope: cross-team infra ownership expected from day 1.
2) Market: competing offer reported; expressed timeline urgency.
3) Performance: consistent high marks from senior interviewers.

If HR is not comfortable with a top-of-band L3 base, propose a one-time sign-on adjustment ($8k) instead of bumping base band. Need decision within 72 hours so we can move quickly.

Karthik
Staff Engineer (hiring manager)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Samira Khan — initial feedback + comp ask

Karthik — thanks for the summary. Monica — can you confirm current L2/L3 bands and whether precedent exists for market adjustments in this profile (inference infra, senior IC)? If we need VP-level approval for any band escalation, call that out so we can route.

Also, please share the combined scorecards and a short paragraph or two that ties the candidate's experience to the higher scope (I can use that to fast-track sign-off). Timeline: we should aim to have an offer out by Friday EOD to stay competitive.

-Aditya
Director, Inference Platform
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Samira Khan — initial feedback + comp ask

Hi all — I reviewed the materials and pulled the comp grid (link below). Summary:
- L2 base range: $120,000 - $145,000
- L3 base range: $150,000 - $180,000
- For candidates clearly assessed at L3, offers should target the L3 midpoint or above when there is competitive pressure.

Policy/approval notes:
- Moving a candidate into a higher band (L2 -> L3) requires documented interview calibration and manager justification (we have that here).
- Base offers above the band maximum or special market adjustments (>5% band stretch) require VP People & Compensation approval.
- One-time sign-on adjustments are permissible up to $10k with HR/People manager approval; anything above needs executive approval.

If we want to proceed with an L3 offer at top-of-band, I can provisionally approve up to $8k sign-on bonus without routing to the VP, provided:
  * We get final manager justification (2-3 paragraphs),
  * All scorecards are uploaded (please attach scorecards_combined.pdf), and
  * Candidate confirms expected timeline (verbal).

Link: https://drive.redwood.com/compensation/guidelines/2026-q4

Monica
Senior HR Business Partner, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Samira Khan — initial feedback + comp ask

Monica — thanks. Uploading the combined scorecards to the drive and summarizing justification below:

Manager justification (for file):
- Role scope: Will own inference-serving performance for 2 product lines; requires independent ownership of KF-style latency projects.
- Evidence: Led a project that reduced P50 latency by 18% at prior employer; interviewers validated system-level tradeoff decisions.
- Leadership: Demonstrated mentorship of junior infra engineers and cross-team stakeholder management.

Recommended offer:
- Band: L3
- Base: $170,000 (top quartile of L3)
- Sign-on: $8,000 one-time
- Equity: standard L3 grant
- Target: Candidate accept by 48-72 hours to avoid losing to competitor.

Attachments: scorecards_combined.pdf (uploaded), samira_interview_notes.docx

If Monica can provisionally approve the $8k sign-on, I will instruct Lauren to proceed with verbal and get formal acceptance paperwork started.

Karthik
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00
Subject: Final — provisional sign-on approval and next steps

Thanks everyone — reviewed the scorecards and manager justification.

HR decision: Provisional approval granted for a one-time sign-on payment of $8,000, conditional on the following:
1) Candidate provides verbal accept within 48 hours of offer extension.
2) Final comp fields (band, base, sign-on amount, equity grant) are recorded in the Offer Approval doc and signed by Aditya (email confirmation is fine).
3) Recruiter obtains written confirmation from candidate on timeline and counter-offer status.

Actions: Lauren — please move forward with verbal offer at L3 base $170,000 + $8k sign-on and standard equity. Share the Offer Approval doc link and confirm once Aditya sends sign-off.

I will process the sign-on once the candidate signs and payroll has the paperwork. Congrats — good hire if we close.

Monica
Senior HR Business Partner
